{{Quote|Victorious we were at Christophsis, but defeated we have been at Selonia, Carida, and Garos Four. Another victory we do require.|Jedi Grand Master Yoda|<ref name="WS" />}}
A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]]<ref name="WS" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="WS" /><ref name="ERC" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was able to defeat the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and win the battle. The Republic's defeat at Selonia, together with other losses, led [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to believe that the Republic would need another victory.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a tie-in novel for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. ''Wild Space'' was written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="WS" />
